input.command: git status && git branch -vv && git log -5 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{upstream} 2>/dev/null; ls -la

git remote -v && git branch -a && git log --oneline --decorate -10 && git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; git merge-base HEAD origin/master 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/.github 2>/dev/null; git show-ref

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && node smoke.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log 2>&1; echo "---"; node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/check.log 2>&1; cat /opt/cursor/artifacts/smoke.log /opt/cursor/artifacts/check.log; gh pr list --head splitter/1111030333-MF-2102/r1/B --json number,url,title,baseRefName 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline splitter/1111030333-MF-2102/r1/A..HEAD 2>/dev/null | head; git merge-base HEAD origin/splitter/1111030333-MF-2102/r1/A; git diff --stat HEAD origin/splitter/1111030333-MF-2102/r1/A | head

cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Block on card/IP country mismatch first, then review new-customer amounts strictly over $500 (50000 cents), otherwise allow. Country codes are trimmed and compared case-insensitively. Alternatives set aside: skipping country checks for repeat customers, treating $500 as review, and attaching multiple reasons when block already wins.
</decision>
<risk>
Reviewers should confirm that repeat customers with a country mismatch are still blocked, and that an amount of exactly $500 is allowed rather than reviewed.
</risk>
<verified>
Ran `node smoke.ts` (function loads) and `node scratch/check.ts` covering allow/review/block, exact $500, repeat high-value, mismatch-vs-review priority, and case/whitespace country matching. All checks passed.
</verified>
EOF
ls -la /opt/cursor/artifacts/
gh pr list --head splitter/1111030333-MF-2102/r1/A --json number,url,title,baseRefName,state 2>/dev/null | head
gh pr list --search "MF-2102" --json number,url,title,headRefName,baseRefName,state --limit 10
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git status && git log -1 --stat
